5624:
** ὠφέλ-ῐμος**, ον,
rarely η, ον, {{Refs|5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Charmides” 174d (uncertain reading), “R.” 607d}}:— **helping, aiding, useful, serviceable, beneficial,** sometimes of persons, as {{Refs 5th c.BC+|[prev. author] “Men.” 98c, “R.” 461b (_comparative_), 5th-6th c.BC: Xenophon Historicus “Memorabilia” 2.7.9}}: but more frequently of things, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Thucydides Historicus 2.46, etc.}}; τινι to one, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Euripides Tragicus “Ion” 138 (Lyric poetry), 5th c.BC: Thucydides Historicus 4.44, 7.64, etc.}}; ἔς τι for a purpose, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|[prev. author] 3.68; πρὸς τὰς πολιτείας 5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Respublica” 607d; ὑπέρ τινος 5th-6th c.BC: Xenophon Historicus “Institutio Cyri (Cyropaedia)” 6.2.34; κρίνειν τι ὠ. 5th c.BC: Thucydides Historicus 1.22}}; τὸ ὠ. as _substantive_, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Respublica” 457d}}; τὸ ὑμῖν ὠ. {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Thucydides Historicus 1.76, compare 5th c.BC: Euripides Tragicus [same place]: _comparative_ and _superlative_, -ώτερος, -ώτατος, 5th c.BC: Thucydides Historicus 1.93, 5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Respublica” 461b, “Tht.” 179a}}. _adverb_ **-μως** {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Xenophon Historicus “Memorabilia” 4.4.1, 5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Gorgias” 470a, “Chrm.” 163c}}: _superlative_ **-ώτατα** {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Xenophon Historicus “de Equitandi ratione” 6.1.}}
